note: The deployment-tool Foundation, pinned to an UNPUBLISHED candidate by
immutable build coordinates rather than by version.
0.3.0a3 is the first Foundation artifact anywhere that can produce an
ExecutionPlanDigestV1 at all: published 0.2.0a2 and the frozen 0.3.0a2
candidate both predate execution_plan.py. Publishing a3 is gated on a
Lane 3 rehearsal whose remaining items are blocked on the Platform CP
issuer that this repository's own cutover deploys, so waiting for a
published version would deadlock the two on each other.
A VERSION is not usable as the pin here, because no index carries this
one. The artifact id and the wheel's sha256 are the identity, and the
digest is verified BEFORE any installer is invoked.
THIS DOES NOT ENTER THE APPLICATION IMAGE. It is absent from
pyproject.toml and from poetry.lock, and the Dockerfile installs only the
`main` dependency group -- so there is no group membership that could
carry it in. It is installed at need into an isolated tool environment
outside this repository by scripts/install_deployment_tool.sh.
`expires_at` is a LEASE, not a note. GitHub deletes the artifact at that
moment and this pin stops resolving; the installer refuses past it rather
than failing obscurely on a 404. Either a3 publishes before then and this
file is replaced by an ordinary `==0.3.0a3` pin, or the capability lapses.
Authorized for exactly two supervised consumers: the first Platform CP
issuer cutover, and Lane 3. Not ERP, not Sub, not ordinary deployment.
